summary.text: Jason Hodgdon is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 41, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the September 8, 2026 Republican primary and has run for the legislature and for Manchester school board in earlier years.

paragraphs.text: Jason Hodgdon won the Republican primary for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 43 in 2018 but was not elected in the general election.
He ran for the Manchester Board of School Committee at-large seat in 2019 and was defeated in the primary.
In 2020 he won the Republican primary for Hillsborough 11 and finished third in the general election for that district's two seats.
In 2025 he ran for Manchester Board of School Committee Ward 4 and lost to incumbent Leslie Want.
